900.2.10(7).explanation: Exception R 7 permits a nursing home, retirement home or religious residence where it takes the whole building and either sits in a building originally built as a detached, semi-detached or townhouse or is on (or near) a major street; a community centre or library need not be City-operated; two sets of named addresses follow their own prevailing by-laws. None of this changes what MaxBLD computes for a house.

900.2.10(4).explanation: Exception R 4 applies exception R 7 to these lands, and a former City of Toronto by-law section (and, on 310 to 320 Gerrard Street East, a former by-law) prevails. MaxBLD does not evaluate the prevailing instruments.
